serviceDescription:
Persistent memory write for AI agents. Stores structured context under your on-chain identity for later semantic recall. First 100 writes per identity are free.
Provide: 1) your ERC-8004 identity address, 2) the memory text up to 8192 characters, 3) optional category and tags.

Semantic recall of your persistent memory. Returns the top ranked entries stored under your on-chain identity.
Provide: 1) your ERC-8004 identity address, 2) a natural language query, 3) optional filters for category and time window.

Bulk memory writes for agents importing a batch of context in one call. Up to 50 memories per request.
Provide: 1) your ERC-8004 identity address, 2) an array of memory entries with content and optional category or tags.

Fetches the most recent memories under your identity to bootstrap a new agent session with prior context.
Provide: 1) your ERC-8004 identity address, 2) an optional limit up to 50 entries.

Seeds starter memories from public on-chain activity for an identity so recall starts with real context instead of an empty book.
Provide: 1) your ERC-8004 identity address, 2) optional lookback depth in blocks.

Creates a wax-sealed decree image for a proposal, milestone, or personal oath tied to your on-chain identity.
Provide: 1) your ERC-8004 identity address, 2) a short subject line, 3) the decree body text, 4) optional sigil style amber, onyx, or cream.

Builds a visual constellation of memories for an on-chain identity as a living shareable artwork that updates as new memories are written.
Provide: 1) your ERC-8004 identity address.

Copies selected memories from your identity to another identity so agents can share portable context without losing ownership provenance.
Provide: 1) your ERC-8004 identity address, 2) the recipient identity address, 3) up to 20 memory ids to share.

Builds a compact dossier from your most recent memories so a new agent session can read who you are in one entry.
Provide: 1) your ERC-8004 identity address, 2) optional entry limit between 5 and 40.

Returns per-identity analytics: category mix, seven-day write timeline, top tags, attestation coverage, and seal count for competition or ops review.
Provide: 1) your ERC-8004 identity address.

Returns a memory constellation graph as nodes and tag-overlap edges so agents can visualize relationships across recent memories.
Provide: 1) your ERC-8004 identity address.

Reads public X Layer wallet holdings via OKX portfolio data and stores a dated portfolio fact under your identity for later recall.
Provide: 1) your ERC-8004 identity address.

Finance copilot memory layer: seeds X Layer wallet history, stores a live portfolio snapshot, and returns semantic recall of your on-chain financial context in one call.
Provide: 1) your ERC-8004 identity address.

One-call bootstrap for a new identity: seed wallet facts, write a preference, build a dossier, sample recall, and return a portrait URL.
Provide: 1) your ERC-8004 identity address, 2) optional preference text.

Returns preferences, facts, pinned memories, and a dossier snapshot so an agent can answer who you are in one call.
Provide: 1) your ERC-8004 identity address.

Lists memories written after a timestamp so a new session can see what changed since last boot.
Provide: 1) your ERC-8004 identity address, 2) an ISO-8601 since timestamp.

Call lifestyle_remember to pin personal facts, preferences, and goals to your ERC-8004 identity so every agent session knows who you are from the first message.
Provide: 1) your ERC-8004 identity address, 2) lifestyle text to remember.
